name: Vöröstó (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and white at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Vöröstó (a red, white and blue shield with bars and a grapevine) below the name VÖRÖSTÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
